If so, to what end? Panda and Putz discuss on the latest episode of the Asia Geopolitics podcast.

In this episode of The Diplomat’s Asia Geopolitics Podcast, hosts Katie Putz and Ankit Panda discuss U.S. President Donald Trump’s upcoming travel itinerary to Asia, to include the ASEAN Summit in Manila, the Philippines, and the APEC Summit in Shenzhen, China. What’s grabbed headlines, however, is the possibility of a trilateral summit with Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin. Putin and Trump have commented on the potential summit, highlighting very different agendas, and China has stayed mostly quiet about it.
Ankit Panda is editor-at-large at The Diplomat and the Stanton Senior Fellow in the Nuclear Policy Program at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace. Follow him on Twitter .
Catherine Putz is managing editor of The Diplomat.
